rule: Every entry is either measured, with an admitted measurement record and a numeric uncertainty, or bound to a named missing-data gate. A study value is a hypothesis or a model output: it keeps the file, span and literal it comes from and is never read as a measurement. A published value for another variant is context only and is never transferable.

status_vocabulary.assumed: A value fixed by a generator or parameter file as a design or operating hypothesis.
status_vocabulary.model_derived: A value computed or estimated from the concept geometry; it describes the model, not a part.
status_vocabulary.numerical_construct: An idealisation of the numerical domain with no physical counterpart to measure.

used_by_historical_cfd_meaning: True when the value appears in an input of the historical CFD chain: a parameter file, the housing or assembly generator, the fluid-domain builder or the case generator. It says the hypothesis was used, not that it is right.

applies_to_vocabulary.physical_turbo: A physical turbocharger; none is identified.

scope_verdict.statement: No entry is measured and no physical unit is identified. The only comparison the evidence supports is a provisional synthetic one: two concept housings sharing one concept wheel, compared numerically at declared hypothetical operating points.
may_claim: A model-internal difference between the two concept housings, once the mesh, solver and uncertainty gates pass
Results labelled with their hypotheses, domain and numerical uncertainty
may_not_claim: Any statement about a K16 or any other physical turbocharger
A compressor map, a maximum flow, an efficiency of a real unit or an engine power
Physical correlation, fit, running clearance, durability or manufacturing release

missing_data_gates.title: No physical reference variant is identified
required_evidence: Which physical turbocharger, if any, the comparison is anchored to
Its identification: data plate, wheel and housing references, handedness, repair history
missing_data_gates.request: Not a measurement task. Naming a unit is a scope decision that rests with the owner; the unit's identification can then be requested from an outside contributor through docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md and docs/MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN.md under decision 0019.

missing_data_gates.title: Rotor metrology is missing
required_evidence: Inducer and exducer diameters, blade count, profile and trim of an identified wheel
Bore, hub and back-face geometry; mass and polar inertia
Instrument, uncertainty, repeats, datum and specimen identity for each reading
missing_data_gates.request: May be requested from an outside contributor through docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md and docs/MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN.md under decision 0019; a bare figure is not admitted.

missing_data_gates.title: Housing, port and reference-geometry metrology is missing
required_evidence: Volute, diffuser and tongue geometry of an identified housing
Inlet and outlet spigot diameter, axis and clocking
CHRA register, backplate face, seal and retention
A licensed scan or drawing with units, frame and datum declared
missing_data_gates.request: May be requested from an outside contributor through docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md and docs/MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN.md under decision 0019.

missing_data_gates.title: Clearances are not measured
required_evidence: Cold tip and shroud clearance, wheel back-face and nut gaps on an identified assembly
Rotor axial end play and radial play with gauge position, load and oil state declared
missing_data_gates.request: May be requested from an outside contributor through docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md and docs/MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN.md under decision 0019. A sampled distance is a diagnostic, never a whole-surface clearance certificate.

missing_data_gates.title: Rotor joint, nut and fastener data are missing
required_evidence: Nut thread, hand, torque and retention
Wheel-to-shaft joint and balance record
missing_data_gates.request: May be requested from an outside contributor through docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md and docs/MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN.md under decision 0019, or found in a licensed service document.

missing_data_gates.title: No compressor map or measured inlet and outlet state
required_evidence: Mass flow, inlet and outlet total pressure and temperature at measured shaft speed
Several speed lines including surge and choke, with the correction reference declared
Exact identity of the tested unit and housings
missing_data_gates.request: Bench data may be accepted from a contributor with a licence grant, or a published dataset may be registered under its licence. Datasets sold by quotation are not pursued: the project buys nothing.

missing_data_gates.title: No measured or documented shaft speed
required_evidence: Operating shaft speed against flow and pressure ratio for the identified unit
Maximum permissible rotor speed from the manufacturer or a qualified test
missing_data_gates.request: Documentary search for a manufacturer limit; an instrumented speed trace may be accepted from a contributor through docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md and docs/MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN.md under decision 0019.

missing_data_gates.title: Turbine side and wastegate are not characterised
required_evidence: Turbine inlet pressure and temperature, outlet pressure, corrected gas flow, speed
Wastegate position and flange geometry
missing_data_gates.request: Bench data may be accepted from a contributor with a licence grant.

missing_data_gates.title: No measured engine operating points
required_evidence: Engine speed, airflow, boost, intake and exhaust pressures and temperatures per bank
Verification of the flow split between banks before halving total flow
missing_data_gates.request: Logged engine data may be accepted from a contributor with a licence grant and no vehicle identifier.

missing_data_gates.title: Oil, bearing and thermal state are unknown
required_evidence: Oil supply pressure and temperature, bearing losses
Wall and metal temperatures, thermal growth of the clearances
Oil feed and drain connection geometry
missing_data_gates.request: Instrumented data may be accepted from a contributor; documentary search for manufacturer oil specifications.

missing_data_gates.title: Materials, processes and allowables are undefined
required_evidence: Alloy, process and heat treatment of each interface part
Allowables and expansion coefficients with their source
missing_data_gates.request: Documentary search and, later, material qualification under professional review; outside this gate's reach.

missing_data_gates.title: No datum scheme, declared frame or tolerances
required_evidence: Datum scheme tying the rotor axis and mating faces to measured features
Tolerances of each interface
Unit and frame declared with every contributed geometry
missing_data_gates.request: Fixed together with any contributed measurement through docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md and docs/MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN.md under decision 0019.

missing_data_gates.title: Numerical idealisations have no measured counterpart and no sensitivity study
required_evidence: Sensitivity of flow and power to the rotating-zone extent, the idealised rear closure, the port extensions and the wall treatment
Prescribed before application, on the qualified mesh route
missing_data_gates.request: Not a measurement request. It is work for the mesh and solver gates, which stay closed.

missing_data_gates.title: Representations are not shown to be equivalent
required_evidence: The prescribed link from rational coordinates to writePrecision 16 text to binary64
Qualification of the full geometry against this ledger
missing_data_gates.request: Not a measurement request. It belongs to issues 397 and 398.
